note: EU/PL supplier paths for PrintNC / LowRider V4 / MPCNC. Lengths and quantities must come from your CAD cutting list; these are sourcing routes, not fixed quotes.

suppliers.notes: Filter 'ships from Germany/Italy'; 0 customs, 3-10 days. PrintNC needs 2 blocks per rail (8 blocks for X/Y).
Often cheapest long rails; check shipping cost.
Buy local - weight kills shipping. Ask for cut-to-length. Get 2-3 quotes.
PETG/PA; cheaper and faster than US import.
Stock often sold out - check availability.

traps: HGR20 + HGW20CC block (flanged), not MGN12 or HGH20.
Rail kit often includes 1 block per rail; PrintNC needs 2 blocks per rail.
Rail/screw lengths come from your CAD cutting list - do not order 'standard' lengths blindly.
Steel: get 2-3 local quotes; full 6m bar can be cheaper than cut pieces.
Electronics from US = VAT + handling + long returns; buy EU warehouse or direct (Elecrow).
Printed MPCNC parts from US: 50+ EUR shipping + customs; print locally or buy from licensed EU vendors.
